ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
A natural number greater than 0 is written on each side of the die shown. All products of opposite numbers are of the same value. What is the smallest possible sum of all 6 numbers?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: I checked the attached figure; in the figure there is a cubic die, and the three visible and pairwise adjacent faces are respectively marked: the top is 10, the front is 15, and the right side is 5. Therefore, the opposite faces of each of these three numbers are hidden faces. Reasoning: Let the common product of all opposite faces be P. The hidden faces opposite to 10, 15, and 5 must also have positive integers written on them, so P/10, P/15, and P/5 must all be positive integers; that is, P must be divisible by 10, 15, and 5 at the same time. To make the sum of the six numbers minimal, the smallest common product should be taken, P = lcm(10,15,5) = 30. Thus the numbers on the three hidden faces are respectively 30/10=3, 30/15=2, and 30/5=6. The sum of the six numbers is 10+15+5+3+2+6=41.

raw_record.question_text: A natural number greater than 0 is written on each side of the die shown. All products of opposite numbers are of the same value. What is the smallest possible sum of all 6 numbers?

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the die shows three mutually adjacent visible faces labeled 10 on top, 15 on the front, and 5 on the right, so their opposite faces are the three hidden faces. From the text, each hidden opposite number is a positive integer and the products of opposite pairs are all equal. Let the common product be P. Then P must be divisible by 10, 15, and 5, because the opposite numbers are P/10, P/15, and P/5. The smallest possible P is lcm(10,15,5)=30. Thus the hidden opposite numbers are 3, 2, and 6. Add all six numbers: 10+15+5+3+2+6=41.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：我检查了附图，图中是一个立方体骰子，三个可见且两两相邻的面分别标有：上面为10，正面为15，右面为5。因此，这三个数各自的对面都是隐藏面。
推理：设所有相对两面的共同乘积为P。与10、15、5相对的隐藏面上也必须写正整数，所以P/10、P/15、P/5都必须是正整数，即P必须同时被10、15、5整除。为了让六个数的总和最小，应取最小的共同乘积P = lcm(10,15,5) = 30。于是三个隐藏面的数分别是30/10=3，30/15=2，30/5=6。六个数的和为10+15+5+3+2+6=41。

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the visible faces of the die are labeled 10, 15, and 5, and they meet at one corner, so no two of them are opposite. Let the hidden numbers opposite 10, 15, and 5 be x, y, and z respectively. From the text, 10x=15y=5z. Compare the first two products: 10x=15y gives 2x=3y, so the smallest positive integer ratio is x:y=3:2, say x=3n and y=2n. Now compare with the 5-face product: 10x=5z, so z=2x=6n. Therefore the hidden numbers are 3n, 2n, and 6n, with smallest positive n=1. The minimum sum is 10+15+5+3+2+6=41.
